notes: All seven required jobs and every recorded step completed successfully in the replacement PR workflow; no skipped gate is counted as passing.

Every job log records checkout fe32a113e4465540c6a8b11730ace07240661880. The GitHub Git commit object for that test merge has the same complete tree as source 9a21c2eb4e2032c6e81afb03092003918a63b272.

The first attempt is preserved separately: two MySQL jobs failed on fixture trigger creation with MySQL error 1419, and the run was cancelled when superseded. Its partial browser artifact is not release acceptance.

The replacement changed only the workflow and two release evidence documents. Disposable MySQL services now assert log_bin_trust_function_creators=1 before add-on fault injection; application credentials, runtime, tests, package builder and all failure-injection assertions were unchanged.

Both downloaded artifact ZIP sizes and SHA-256 digests exactly match GitHub metadata and their archive integrity checks pass. All three customer ZIPs and the package manifest are byte-for-byte identical to the frozen local release.

The actual CI desktop and mobile add-on JSON records both identify version 0.8.3 / Build 20261020.4, PHP 8.3.35, Playwright 1.62.0 and Chromium 151.0.7922.34, with 33 passed checks each. Six fixture-only PNGs were extracted unchanged; no additional visual-review claim is inferred from extraction.
Actual merge dcb229532ce55e4783b477d51bc3ffbe3f7fcfa7 was independently fetched after merge; its full tree equals both the tested merge and source trees.
These checks exercise disposable local and CI fixtures, including real MySQL and actual customer packages. They do not establish actual-host production deployment or live payment acceptance.
